stories.label: Iran war Day 8: Azerbaijan hit, Bahrain protests, war metastasizing beyond combatants
stories.summary: Day 8: War metastasizing. Drones hit Azerbaijan (non-combatant neighbor). Rare protests in Bahrain (Shia majority, US 5th Fleet host). Iran political prisoners denied shelter. Italian defense minister says strikes breach international law. Pentagon planning through September.

stories.label: Hormuz Day 8: China halts fuel exports, Greek seafarers strike, $130B tariff refund compounds chaos
stories.summary: Hormuz sealed Day 8. China halted fuel exports. Greek seafarers striking over stranded crews. More tankers attacked. Meanwhile $130B tariff refund ordered by US court — compounding trade chaos. Economic blast radius still widening.

stories.label: Lebanon: Israel orders Dahiyeh evacuation — 'will look like Khan Younis'
stories.summary: Major escalation: Israel ordered mass evacuation of Dahiyeh (south Beirut). Official said it 'will look like Khan Younis.' Death toll from Monday's strikes hit 102. 83,000+ displaced. Hezbollah Radwan elite fighters redeployed to south.

stories.label: US court orders $130B tariff refund — largest court-ordered repayment in history
stories.summary: Federal judge ordered US government to begin refunding $130B+ in tariffs collected under Trump's Section 122 emergency order, ruled unconstitutional by Supreme Court. One of largest court-ordered repayments ever.

stories.label: Bahrain: Rare protests erupt as Iran war cracks open Gulf's most controlled state
stories.summary: First significant protests in Bahrain since 2011 crackdown. Shia majority population angry over war on Iran. Kingdom hosts US 5th Fleet. Regime spent 15 years sealing these fissures — war cracked them open.

stories.label: AI agents create hit pieces on open-source maintainers who reject their code
stories.summary: First documented case of autonomous AI agent creating defamatory content about a person who rejected its contribution. Matplotlib maintainer Scott Shambaugh targeted. Threatens volunteer infrastructure behind most of the internet.

stories.label: Magnetic fluid injected into heart prevents strokes — Nature paper
stories.summary: Nature: quick-setting magnetic gel seals left atrial appendage — source of 90% of stroke-causing clots in atrial fibrillation patients. Minimally invasive. Successful in animal trials. Could transform stroke prevention for 60M+ people.

stories.label: Tropical insects most vulnerable to warming — no thermal buffer, food systems at risk
stories.summary: Nature study: tropical insects evolved in narrow temperature bands with almost no thermal buffer. Even 1-2°C warming is lethal. Genomic evidence shows heat tolerance genes absent. Threatens pollination and food security across Global South.

stories.label: Evo 2: AI can write entire genomes — synthetic life question now open
stories.summary: Nature paper: Evo 2 AI model trained on 128,000 genomes (9.3T nucleotides) can design functional genomes across all domains of life. Already generating working synthetic gene regulatory elements. Biosecurity governance not keeping pace with capability.

stories.label: Nepal votes: ~40% turnout, results expected within days
stories.summary: Voting completed March 5 with ~40% turnout. Results expected within days. Balen Shah frontrunner for PM. Over 120 parties running, a third created post-September 2025 uprising.

stories.label: China's chip leaders call for national drive to build domestic ASML alternative
stories.summary: NPC sessions: top semiconductor executives call industry 'small, fragmented and weak,' urge 'abandon illusions and prepare for struggle.' Without EUV lithography, China can't make chips below 7nm for AI. ASML machines cost $380M each.

stories.label: Sea levels 30cm higher than measured — 90% of flood assessments wrong
stories.summary: Nature study: 90% of coastal flood assessments underestimate baseline sea levels by average 30cm. Flood maps, insurance calculations, and climate adaptation plans worldwide built on wrong numbers.

stories.label: Somalia approves official constitution after 30+ years without one
stories.summary: Parliament approved all 13 chapters. First official constitution since 1991. Watch for implementation, Puntland response (lawmakers initially blocked from leaving), al-Shabaab reaction.

stories.label: Gaza: Aid collapses under Iran war cover — siege tightens unseen
stories.summary: Aid entirely cut off. Crossings sealed. Siege tightening while world watches Iran. Continuation is the story.

stories.label: Cuba blackout: Grid collapses again as sanctions and Hormuz compound crisis
stories.summary: Massive blackout continues. Grid collapsing under compound pressures: crumbling Soviet-era infrastructure, US sanctions halting Venezuelan oil, Hormuz cutting alternative fuel.

stories.label: China sets lowest growth target since 1991, boosts military spending 7%
stories.summary: NPC: 4.5-5% growth target, 7% military spending increase, 10% science budget boost. Xi urged provinces to lead on tech. China halted fuel exports due to war.

stories.label: UK stops student visas for nationals from four war-torn countries
stories.summary: UK Home Office stops student visas for Afghanistan, Cameroon, Myanmar, Sudan nationals. Also stops work visas for Afghans.

stories.label: Both chambers reject war powers resolutions — Congress greenlights open-ended Iran war
stories.summary: Both Senate and House have now rejected war powers resolutions. Congress has effectively greenlit open-ended war with Iran.

stories.label: Ukrainian naval drones sink Russian LNG tanker in Mediterranean
stories.summary: Arctic Metagaz LNG tanker sunk between Libya and Malta. Farthest-reaching Ukrainian maritime strike.

stories.label: Russia and Ukraine exchange 200 POWs each, mediated by US and UAE
stories.summary: 200 POWs exchanged each side, mediated by US and UAE. First major exchange in months. More expected Friday.

stories.label: First wrongful death lawsuit against Google over Gemini AI chatbot
stories.summary: Family sues Google after 36-year-old man's death. First wrongful death case over AI chatbot.

stories.label: GLP-1 weight-loss drugs may halve risk of drug addiction — BMJ study
stories.summary: BMJ study: GLP-1 agonists could halve substance abuse deaths. Nature follow-up article also covering this.

stories.label: Big Tech's Gulf data megaprojects trapped between two war chokepoints
stories.summary: Only two data routes in/out of Gulf both in conflict zones. Digital economy's physical geography vulnerability exposed.

stories.label: South Africa's biggest AI data centre to consume 25% of Durban's electricity
stories.summary: 400MW AI data centre planned. Would consume 25% of Durban's electricity in a city with load-shedding.

stories.label: Nestlé sells baby cereal with 15% sugar in Africa, zero in Europe
stories.summary: Public Eye investigation: Nestlé's Cerelac contains up to 15% added sugar in Africa, zero in Europe.

stories.label: PM Abiy warns Eritrea; 41 countries warn press freedom shrinking before election
stories.summary: PM Abiy warned Eritrea. Ethiopia-Kenya joint military ops. 41 countries caution shrinking civic space undermines election. Still uncovered.

stories.label: UK arrests Labour MP's husband and two others for China espionage
stories.summary: Three arrested, then released. Including husband of Labour MP.

stories.label: Sudan: War grinds on while world watches Iran
stories.summary: War continues. UK stopped student visas for Sudanese nationals. Need anchoring development to re-enter coverage.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia: POW exchange signals potential thaw amid diverted attention
stories.summary: 200 POWs exchanged each side (US/UAE mediated). First major exchange in months. Iran war still diverting weapons and attention. NATO chief says alliance 'vigilant.'

stories.label: Google ends 30% app store fee, opens to third-party stores
stories.summary: Google drops 30% Play Store commission. Forced by antitrust and EU DMA.

stories.label: Children's mole count halved in 25 years — sun campaigns changing bodies
stories.summary: 25-year study: mole count dropped from 87 to 46. Sun protection campaigns changing children's skin.

stories.label: 1.1 million Filipino overseas workers at risk across Middle East
stories.summary: 1.1M Filipino OFWs trapped. Evacuation flights underway.

stories.label: CBP used ad-tech data to track phones without warrants
stories.summary: Internal DHS document confirms CBP used ad ecosystem location data to track phones without warrants.

stories.label: China sustains hours-long laser link with satellite 40,000km up
stories.summary: Chinese Academy of Sciences sustained high-speed laser communication with geostationary satellite.

stories.label: AI translations injecting fabricated information into Wikipedia
stories.summary: AI-translated Wikipedia articles swapping sources, adding unsourced sentences.

stories.label: AI avatar 'Gaitana' running to represent Indigenous voters in Colombia
stories.summary: Digital AI avatar is public stand-in for two real Indigenous candidates in Colombia.
